tasks.label: 查看 QuestDB 磁盘占用
args: $dockerRoot = 'D:\DockerData'; $vhdx = Join-Path $dockerRoot 'wsl\disk\docker_data.vhdx'; Write-Host "Docker 数据目录: $dockerRoot" -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path $vhdx) { $file = Get-Item $vhdx; Write-Host ("Docker VHDX: {0:N2} GB" -f ($file.Length / 1GB)) -ForegroundColor Green }; $status = (docker desktop status 2>$null | Out-String); if ($status -match 'running') { docker system df -v } else { Write-Host 'Docker Desktop 当前未运行，无法读取卷内明细。' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; $drive = Get-PSDrive D; Write-Host ("D 盘剩余: {0:N2} GB" -f ($drive.Free / 1GB)) -ForegroundColor Yellow

tasks.label: 准备 Grafana 服务
args: $status = (docker desktop status 2>$null | Out-String); if ($status -notmatch 'running') { docker desktop start | Out-Host }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { $status = (docker desktop status 2>$null | Out-String); if ($status -match 'running') { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; if ($status -notmatch 'running') { throw 'Docker Desktop 未启动完成，请稍后重试。' }; docker compose up -d grafana
